name.description: Required on named events (2–30 characters trimmed), absent on anonymous ones.

votes.description: One state per option ID: every option of the event exactly once.

CastVote.description: A participant’s answer to every option of the event.

HealthOk.description: The API and its database answer.

state.description: Closed once the deadline has passed, even before anything else changes it.

PublicEvent.description: What a participant may see of an event: never the organizer email, tokens, counts or votes.

time.description: Null for a whole day; times only appear on single dates.

ValidationFailed.description: The request breaks the contract (e.g. a path with broken percent-encoding, a body that is not JSON).

FieldProblem.description: A part of the request that breaks its schema.

EventCancelled.description: The event was cancelled; its title is kept.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this address; the `Retry-After` header says how many seconds to wait.

InternalError.description: The request failed unexpectedly; it can be retried.

VoteCast.description: The stored vote; the same answer for a repeated send.

VoteRejected.description: Nothing was stored: the request breaks the contract, the vote breaks a rule of the event, or the token already belongs to a vote of another event.

VotingClosed.description: The deadline has passed, the organizer closed voting or confirmed a date.

name.description: The trimmed name; absent on anonymous events.

votes.description: One state per option ID of the event.

MyVote.description: The answer stored under a vote-edit token.

Forbidden.description: The token holds no vote of this event (none at all, or one of another event).

EditVoteRejected.description: Nothing was changed: the request breaks the contract or the vote breaks a rule of the event.

final.description: False while voting is open (the results are provisional), true after.

outcome.description: Which sentence the results say: no winner (`no-votes`, `nobody-can-attend`), one, two, three or four or more winners (`several`), or every option winning (`all`).

attending.description: Voters who can attend a winner; 0 with no winner.

winnersListed.description: Whether the winners are listed under the sentence: one to three.

alternatives.description: As well attended as the winners but less preferred: most preferred first, then in chronological order.

Results.description: What the votes of an event amount to: the winners and their alternatives, never a full ranking.

ResultsOption.description: One option shown in the results; its attendance is `preferred + available`.

ResultsForbidden.description: The ID is the participation link of an event, which never opens its results.

state.description: Closed once the deadline has passed, even before anything else changes it.

recommendedOptionIds.description: The options the results recommend (their winners), in chronological order; empty with no votes or when nobody can attend.

participationId.description: The ID of the participation link.

resultsId.description: The ID of the results link.

ManagedEvent.description: What the organizer sees of an event to manage it, with the facts a decision needs: how many voted and which options are recommended.

Unauthenticated.description: The request carries no credential that could grant it.

ManagementForbidden.description: The credential does not manage this event: another event’s token, any other link, or an event that does not exist.
